text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":119,"unit":"matchboxes","kind":"count","span":"119 matchboxes"},{"id":"q2","value":9,"unit":"houses","kind":"count","span":"distribute the matchboxes equally to the 9 houses"}],"plan":[{"op":"div","args":["q1","q2"],"out":"s1","note":"matchboxes divided by houses gives how many each house would get"},{"op":"mul","args":["s1","q2"],"out":"s2","note":"matchboxes per house times number of houses gives matchboxes distributed"},{"op":"sub","args":["q1","s2"],"out":"s3","note":"total matchboxes minus distributed matchboxes gives the leftover"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"number of matchboxes left over after equal distribution to the 9 houses"},"dismissed":[]}
